senses.gloss: (כָּפַח) [a pouched receptacle,] a small stove, brazier.
units: Ib. 38ᵇ כ׳ מקום שפיתת וכ׳ a kuppaḥ is a stove which has room only for one pot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 5:9">Men. V, 9</cite> <he>מאפה כ׳</he> what is baked in a brazier.
Kel. V, 2 הכ׳ עשאו לאפייה … לבישול a k. made for baking, … for cooking.
